newsitem.title: DENMARK: SAS share climbs 7.55 pct on optimism.
newsitem.headline: SAS share climbs 7.55 pct on optimism.

text.p: Scandinavian Airlines System (SAS) share price climbed 7.55 percent on Thursday on growing optimism about the airline's performance and foreign interest.
At 1215 GMT the share stood at 114 crowns, eight crowns up from Wednesday's close in turnover of 799,000 shares.

Dealers attributed the rise to recent buy recommendations from London banks, improved SAS passenger volume figures and growing optimism about the airline's future earnings within the Star Alliance with Lufthansa and others. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
